verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents managed remote browser sessions that developers create, control, and observe, and it advertises a live view. The evidence frames these sessions as programmatic and agent-driven, though, and never shows a human manually driving the browser. missing for 10: documented human-interactive manual browsing (e.g. a controllable live view or takeover), explicit sandbox isolation details, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can access a managed remote browser sandbox for interactive, manual browsing workflows

citations.quote: Create, control, and observe browser sessions programmatically.

the official `@browserbasehq/sdk` package is the easiest way
to connect to and control headless browsers running on Browserbase.
best-in-class observability (rich logs, live view, and session replay)
